status: Land-pattern evidence for the DA-01 D3 working codes; NOT SELECTED. MMS and CLT copper now SOURCED from the Samtec layouts (ST-01c). Courtyards are derived envelopes, not footprints.
frame: Same frame as design/stack/geometry/land-pattern.json: width_mm across the contact row, length_mm along it; courtyard = outer extent of copper and body outline, grown by courtyard_growth_mm on every side.

da01_check.row_length_(n-1)x2.00+1.02: CONFIRMED as the copper extent along the row, but CORRECTED for the courtyard: the recommended layout draws the connector outline as 'NO OF POS x 2.00' (sheet 3, top dimension) and the print gives body length n x 2.00 +/- 0.25 (CW sheet 1, fig 1), which is 0.98 mm longer than the copper. Courtyard length = n x 2.00 + 0.25 tolerance + 2 x 0.25 growth.
da01_check.stacker_courtyard_width_6_04: CONFIRMED: 5.54 + 2 x 0.25; the 4.95 mm maximum tail span and 2.00 mm body width are inside the pads.
da01_check.mms_socket_pattern_st01c: MMS -SV copper SOURCED (layout revision C): 1.016 x 2.085 staggered pads, 5.44 span, 0.86 pass-through holes; courtyard 5.94 x (2n + 1.19).
